artworks.title: Martyrdom of Saint Lucy
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring numerous figures in elaborate garments gathered around a central staircase. The composition is crowded with characters in dynamic poses, interacting with each other in varied expressions. There are architectural elements in the background, including columns, arches, and a distant cityscape. The attire of the characters and the architecture suggest a historical or mythological narrative. The arrangement of the figures suggests a story unfolding, where each character seems to play a role in the drama.

artworks.title: Abraham's Sacrifice
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Gebel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures and a burning altar. The image depicts a scene showing a figure with a sword on his back standing next to a kneeling figure near an altar. An angelic figure emerges from swirling clouds above them, reaching out with one hand. The setting shows rolling hills, a village, and a dense wooded area. There are substantial curvilinear lines in the clouds and the angel's garments. The drawing has high contrast between the ink lines and the lighter background.

artworks.title: Grim Spain
artworks.medium: etching (copper) on japan paper in dark brown
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Gebel
artworks.description: The image shows a scene of rugged terrain with structures in the distance. The foreground features rocky earth leading to dilapidated buildings on the left. The skyline is elevated on the right with a chimney emitting smoke. In the distance, there are rooftops and slender forms suggesting more architecture and trees. The etching is colored in muted sepia tones.

artworks.title: Moses and the Burning Bush
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Gebel
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a deity-like figure emerging from clouds above a landscape with grazing sheep and a kneeling man. The drawing depicts a dramatic scene with a classical theme, presenting a bearded, flowing-robed figure partially shrouded in clouds, gesturing towards a kneeling man who is on the edge of a cliff or hill. The left side of the drawing shows a cluster of sheep peacefully grazing. In the background, there is a pastoral landscape with trees and distant rolling hills scattered with quaint buildings. The composition is detailed with fine lines, showcasing a traditional style typical of Renaissance-era sketches, focusing on expressive figures and narrative interplay.

artworks.title: Peasant Family Entertained by a Fiddler with a Hunchback
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Gebel
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with a bustling family gathering outside a rustic building. A group of people are near the entrance of a house. Two adults are talking while another adult watches a child playing with a hoop. The stone structure appears aged, with detailed etching lines showing texture. The architecture includes diamond-pane windows and an arched entryway. In the distance, a tower and foliage can be seen. The etching uses intricate line work, shading, and cross-hatching for depth and texture. The monochromatic color palette enhances the details and creates a vintage atmosphere.

artworks.title: Marin Cureau de la Chambre
artworks.artist: Antoine Masson after Pierre Mignard I
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust-length portrait of an older man facing the viewer. He has an aged face with a long nose, medium lips, prominent eyes, and facial hair. He has curly hair extending past his shoulders, framing his face and wearing a dark outfit with a white lace collar. The portrait is a detailed engraving with fine shading, enclosed in a circular border, with a Latin inscription below the portrait.

artworks.title: Antoine Turgot
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man in a portrait framed within an oval border. He is slightly turned to his left, looking towards the viewer. The man has pronounced facial features with a straight nose and full lips, and long, curly hair that extends past his shoulders. He is wearing a dark robe with a white collar. The oval frame is decorated with leaf and ribbon motifs, and at the bottom, a coat of arms surrounded by detailed embellishments is displayed. The background is filled with dense cross-hatching.

artworks.title: Guillaume de Brisacier
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a man facing slightly to his right. He has long, wavy hair, facial features with a broad nose, slightly upturned lips, and a mustache. He is wearing a dark robe over a large white collar. There is an oval frame with French text at the top and an ornate coat of arms at the bottom. The background inside the frame has a stippled texture.

artworks.title: Cardinal de Bouillon
artworks.description: The image shows a person depicted in a detailed engraving from the chest up, positioned three-quarters to the viewer, with their head slightly turned to the side. The individual has curly hair, full cheeks, and a serene expression. They wear clothing typical of nobility or clergy, including a high collar and textured garment, with a cross pendant around their neck. The portrait is enclosed within an ornate oval frame with inscriptions, a coat of arms, and decorative elements. The background features fine horizontal lines for texture.

artworks.title: Pere Ives
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an elderly man seated and facing slightly to the left. He has distinct facial features, a long white beard, and sparse hair on top with some hair on the sides and back. He is wearing a long robe and holding a sheet of paper or a book. The background is plain with simple line work for shading.

artworks.title: Francois de Villemontee
artworks.description: The image portrays the upper half of a man's body. He is seated and facing slightly to the right. The man has a mustache, goatee, and medium-length wavy hair. He wears a cap, high-collared garment, and a buttoned jacket. A cross hangs around his neck. The background features an oval frame, with intricate line work and a decorative crest below the oval.

artworks.title: Jean Perrault
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up, facing slightly to the right with a calm expression. He has wavy hair falling to his neck and facial hair including a mustache and a small beard. He is wearing a dark long-sleeved robe with a decorative collar. The background is textured and frames the central oval portrait, which includes an ornate crest with a coat of arms below it.

artworks.title: Louis XIV as a Boy
artworks.description: The image shows an etched portrait of a young person in a formal pose. The person is facing slightly to the right, with their head turned towards the viewer. They have delicate facial features and shoulder-length wavy hair. The individual is dressed in an ornate garment with intricate patterns, including a high lace collar and a draped sash. The portrait is in an oval border against a background of fine lines. Below the oval frame, there is a crowned letter "L." The engraving features detailed line work highlighting the attire and the person's expression.

artworks.title: Jean Habert de Monturor
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the chest up, positioned centrally within an oval frame. The man is facing the viewer at a slight angle, displaying a composed expression with a gentle smile. His facial features include a mustache and a pointed beard, and he has wavy hair that tapers at the back. He is dressed in formal attire typical of the era, with a wide collar and a cloak. Flanking the portrait are two cherubic figures, one on either side, both of whom are depicted nude. The left cherub is seated on a pedestal, resting its hand on a skull atop an urn, while the right cherub is playfully interacting with an ornate vase. Above the portrait are drapery elements, with inscriptions and a decorative urn at the top center. The background beyond these elements is textured with fine lines.

artworks.title: Charles Favre
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man's body. The man is positioned facing slightly to the left but looking directly at the viewer. His facial features include a prominent nose, and a defined jawline, and he has a calm expression. He has short, dark hair that is neatly combed. The man is wearing a long, draped garment that appears to be a robe, with a high, stiff collar. The background of the image is a series of tightly spaced lines that create an oval shape around the figure, suggesting an engraved texture that frames the portrait. There is no visible jewelry, and he is not holding any objects. At the bottom of the image, there is a block of text that appears to identify the person depicted.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.description: The image displays three figures. A woman is seated, holding a child on her lap. Both are shown from their torsos up. The woman looks down at the child. The child is naked and securely held in the woman's arms. Beside them, a man is kneeling on one knee, slightly higher than them, shown from head to waist. He has short hair, a beard, and is wearing a long garment, with one arm extended holding a cloth. The background consists of rustic elements with old brick or stone walls. A donkey is tethered behind the woman and child, with a small evergreen tree or bush in the upper left corner and a stone engraved slab or tablet in the lower left.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.description: The image shows two figures. One is upright, with arms stretched out horizontally on a cross, head tilted downward. This person has long, waved hair and wears a crown of thorns, with a solemn expression on their face. They wear a modest cloth draped around their waist. At their feet, another person is shown kneeling and embracing the base of the cross. This second individual has long, flowing hair and wears a loose garment. In the background, there is a barren and rugged terrain under a cloud-filled sky, with a castle visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Saint Alexis
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure lying on his back on the ground near a staircase. He is wearing a robe with a cross on the chest and appears to be holding an object. The scene includes an architectural setting with stone walls, stairs, two figures conversing in the background, and another figure observing from the top of the stairs. The sun is shining, casting light on the stone structure.

artworks.title: Saint Augustine
artworks.description: The image shows a man kneeling with his hands clasped together against a tree. His head is slightly tilted back as he gazes upwards. The man has a beard and curly hair, wearing a simple robe. In the background, there is a rural setting with trees, bushes, and a fence enclosing a seated figure. The sky is visible with tree leaves and branches.

artworks.title: Saint Benedict
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person against a backdrop of clouds. The person is in a kneeling position with their head tilted upwards, gazing at a circular object resembling a sun or an eclipse. Their face has a solemn expression with defined features including a long nose and arched eyebrows, and the person's hair is mostly concealed under a hood. The individual is wearing a robe with wide sleeves. No visible jewelry or objects are present. The background is filled with clouds, with a bright orb emitting rays in the top left corner.

artworks.title: John Ogilvy
artworks.artist: William Faithorne after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person with long, curly hair, wearing historical formal attire within an intricately detailed oval frame. The background has a textured pattern, and below the portrait is the name "JOHANNES OGILVIUS" along with artist inscriptions "P. Lilly Pinxit" on the left and "Gul. Faithorne Sculp." on the right.

artworks.title: James Drummond, Earl of Perth
artworks.artist: William Faithorne after Sir Peter Lely
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait engraving of a man with a long, oval face, a slightly prominent nose, and curly hair cascading down to his shoulders. He is looking directly at the viewer with an expressionless gaze. The man is wearing a richly textured gown with a lace collar. In the background, an ornate oval frame with decorative elements and a crest or coat of arms, along with text identifying the subject as "James Earle of Perth Drummond &c. Aetat: 31."

artworks.title: Antoine Vitre
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in a side-facing position but looking directly at the viewer. He has distinct facial features with a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and a mustache. He has long, wavy hair extending to his shoulders and a high forehead. The man wears a dark cloak over a buttoned garment, accessorized with a bracelet on his wrist. He holds a rolled piece of paper, suggesting scholarly attributes. The background is plain. In front of him, there is a ruler and paper, implying a theme of study or intellectual pursuit.

artworks.title: Pierre Berthier
artworks.artist: Jean Morin after Philippe de Champaigne
artworks.description: The image shows a man's upper body, facing slightly to his left but looking directly at the viewer. The man has a mustache, beard, medium-length wavy dark hair, and wears formal clergy attire with a broad collar, robe, and zucchetto (skullcap). He also wears a cross pendant on a chain around his neck. The background is a simple, textured surface.
